title: Derivation of the Polar Area Element via the Jacobian
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Verify that the Jacobian of the polar coordinate transformation x = r cos(theta), y = r sin(theta) is equal to r.

steps.title: Compute Partial Derivatives
steps.mathExpression: \frac{\partial x}{\partial r} = \cos\theta, \; \frac{\partial x}{\partial \theta} = -r\sin\theta; \quad \frac{\partial y}{\partial r} = \sin\theta, \; \frac{\partial y}{\partial \theta} = r\cos\theta
steps.explanation: Differentiate Cartesian coordinates with respect to r and theta.

steps.title: Compute Determinant
steps.explanation: Apply fundamental trigonometric identity cos^2(theta) + sin^2(theta) = 1.
